SK Matka aur SM Matka — Sawal-Jawab

SK Matka — jise log SM Matka, SM Satta Matka ya SK Satta bhi kehte hain — Prof. S.K. Jain ka result aur chart platform hai (khabar.bet). Live result, har game ka SK chart, guessing forum aur Daily / Weekly / Monthly chart ek hi jagah.

SK Matka aur SM Matka me kya fark hai?

Koi fark nahi — dono isi site ke naam hain. Kuch log ise S M, SMS ya SMR likh kar bhi dhoondhte hain.

Kisi bazar ka result kitne baje aata hai?

Result board par har bazar ke card me uska open aur close ka samay likha hai. Result aate hi wahi card aur upar ka Live Updates badal jaata hai.

SK Chart kahan milega?

Result board par har game ke card ke neeche wala button dabaiye — us game ka jodi aur panel chart khulta hai.

Milte-julte naam wale bazar ek hi hain kya?

Nahi. Jaise Madhur aur Madhuri, ya Kalyan aur Kalyan Night — ye alag bazar hain, alag samay par khulte hain. Result dekhte waqt card ka naam dhyan se padhiye.

Delhi bazar ka result kaise dikhta hai?

Disawar, Gali, Faridabad, Ghaziabad jaise Delhi ke bazar ka ek hi number aata hai — card par aaj ka number aur uske saath pichhle din ka number dikhta hai.

Satta Batta kya hai?

Satta matka ke result aur chart ke liye log ye shabd bhi search karte hain. Satta Batta naam se jo bazar dhoondhe jaate hain, wo sab yahan ke board par hain.

SM Matka 143 / Satta Matta Matka 143 kya hai?

Ye naam guessing ke liye use hote hain. Is site ke guessing forum me khiladi har bazar ke liye apni guessing likhte hain, aur Daily Chart tab me us din ka chart milta hai.

Naya result dekhne ke liye page refresh karna padta hai?

Nahi. Live Updates aur result board result aate hi apne aap badal jaate hain.
